Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions continue to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Sign-in hint (6 wins across 15 tests), home wait_info (4 wins across 11 tests), adoption new_flow (3 wins across 5 tests), and finish new_flow (2 wins across 9 tests) were helpful.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path redesign changes consistently failed to improve performance across 4 tests.
Choose_path copy, home redesign, home new_screen, and adoption incentive changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once (e.g., finish copy, finish layout, finish redesign, home new_flow).

            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Account Companion Restore Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in will automatically bring back their previously saved desktop pets and settings.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making account recovery reassurance a top priority.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically restores your existing pets and saved desktop preferences.

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Trait Calibration Flow
candidates.change: Insert an interactive trait calibration sub-flow before certificate signing where users fine-tune their pet's default personality and behavior parameters.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (71.9%) and support received complaints about custom pets failing or looking wrong. A calibration flow sets better expectations.

new_trait_calibration.headline: Calibrate Companion Traits
new_trait_calibration.body: Adjust your pet's desktop activity levels and behavioral style before completing adoption.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Hatching Stage Live Progress Log
candidates.change: Enable time estimates and step progress displays on the waiting screen while desktop pet asset generation completes in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s. Showing clear wait information has proven effective in past home tests.

waiting.hint: Your pet asset is generating in the background. You can minimize this window at any time.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Gesture Guide Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive gesture tutorial screen right before finishing onboarding to walk users through dragging, summoning, and hiding their desktop companion.
candidates.why: Support logged multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-setup.

new_gesture_guide.headline: Master Desktop Pet Gestures
new_gesture_guide.body: Try out dragging, right-clicking for commands, and using system tray shortcuts before entering your desktop.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout that highlights a live preview of the companion alongside official adoption confirmation details.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (71.9%), and visually highlighting the finished pet builds momentum before rendering starts.

candidates.title: Account Pet Data Cloud Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Add explicit cloud safety copy under sign-in options confirming that pet data is backed up safely across logins.
candidates.why: Sign-in hints have a high historical win rate (6/15) and address the 8 support emails concerning lost pet data upon re-login.

sign_in.hint: Your pet memory and customized traits are safely synced to cloud storage.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Action Menu Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated screen in the finish sequence demonstrating the system tray quick action menu for hiding and managing the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Users frequently report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to minimize or talk to the pet once setup concludes.

new_quick_action_menu.headline: System Tray & Quick Controls
new_quick_action_menu.body: Use the tray menu icon anytime to hide your pet, tweak sound effects, or trigger desktop interactions.

candidates.title: Desktop Hatch Ready System Tray Alert Switch
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification toggles on the waiting screen so users get alerted immediately when pet rendering finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a mean duration over 38 minutes (2336s), indicating users step away while pet generation finishes.

waiting.hint: We'll send a system tray notification as soon as your companion is ready on your desktop.

candidates.title: Choose Path Pet Customization Option Hint
candidates.change: Add a clear guidance hint on the choose_path screen explaining that users can pick preset pets or build a custom pet from photo uploads.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-off is 20.3% (79.7% completion), and clarifying path differences reduces hesitation without risky screen redesigns.

choose_path.hint: Select between instant ready-to-play companions or generate a custom pet from your photo upload.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Pet Selection Grid Layout
candidates.change: Switch the friend selection layout to a multi-column grid that displays preset companions clearly side by side.
candidates.why: Improving visual clarity during pet selection helps reduce adoption step drop-off (71.9%).
